about: Routing-only probes for the HIPAA rubric (reference/applicability/hipaa.md). Each case is a scenario plus optional text appended to request fields. 'expect' is the rubric author's expected routing, not a legal compliance claim. Cases marked 'plain:' avoid rubric vocabulary (no 'claims', 'health plan', 'business associate', 'covered'), in the everyday register of the ICGP GP data guideline v3 (Nov 2025) processor and insurer examples, to test judgement rather than term matching.

cases.name: 19 base: IE GP to DE cloud

append./transfer/onward: A second backup copy is stored by a US cloud storage company in Virginia.

append./organisations/0/description: For visiting US patients, the practice submits claims electronically to their US health insurers and is paid by them.

append./organisations/1/description: The provider also hosts member records for US health plans as their business associate.
